title: RoboCup Humanoid Perception
text: Vision, efficient inference and probabilistic localization
sub:
Yacine Zahouani
ITA-ITAndroids, supervised by Marcos Maximo
Public engineering overview
refs: Project reports [6]-[21]. Public edition 1.0.0. Original diagrams and aggregate redraws by Yacine Zahouani. This is a self-contained portfolio overview, not the administrative school deck.

title: Perception connects image evidence to robot pose
text: My contributions span evaluation design, model research, CPU tooling and probabilistic system debugging.
refs: Reports [6]-[21]. The robot, inherited team software and established architecture families predate this research.

title: Reliable labels change which results we can trust
text:
Corrected line masks and deterministic preprocessing
Sequence and near-duplicate exposure audits
54 and 66 overlapping groups in two historical splits
sub: Line Dice 0.8488 on corrected final-only evidence
refs: Reports [6]-[7]. These are counts from distinct historical splits, not a 54/66 ratio. The explicit-line task is distinct from binary field segmentation.

title: Field quality and CPU cost favor different specialists
text: Fast-SCNN: 13.079 ms four-thread p95 on the NUC. MobileNet: strongest field-quality reference.
refs: Reports [8]-[9]. Quality comes from the open 77-image bridge. NUC measurements are actual hardware evidence. Binary field exports have constant detector placeholders.

title: YOLO26 is faster, with a measurable accuracy tradeoff
text: Same data, three seeds. 46% lower NUC four-thread p95 for YOLO26, without complete accuracy noninferiority.
refs: Reports [10]-[11]. 12,018 images. mAP50-95 0.529598 versus 0.519570. Runtime 164.389 versus 88.471 ms. Historical and production anchors have incompatible accuracy protocols.

title: Private field semantics support strong shared perception
text: Selected field quality approaches the specialist. Matched controls isolate capacity, adaptation and distillation.
refs: Reports [12]-[13]. Open development evidence only. Efficient selected-seed Dice 0.990232. Confirmation seed sensitivity, strict raw parity failures and a 6.55% pooled laptop CPU gain limit promotion.

title: Deterministic simulation exposes downstream behavior
text:
16 scenarios and 2,250 synchronized frames
Actual ITAndroids perception path in ROS/Gazebo
Geometry and temporal evidence for causal tests
sub: Field-context reranking improved stress cases, then regressed on untouched replay.
refs: Reports [14]-[15]. Synthetic GT supports ball/goalpost boxes and L/T centers, not robot/X box scores. Stress: 300 off-field accepts reduced to zero. Untouched replay recall fell 1.708 percentage points. Simulator timing is not NUC timing.

title: Landmark measurements retain most oracle benefit
text: Actual measurements with correct map identity recover 79.5% of median oracle gain. Learned identity remains difficult.
refs: Report [16]. Gazebo, synthetic command odometry, oracle identity diagnostic only. Baseline/exact/actual-ID/learned medians 0.971/0.299/0.437/0.641 m. Learned p95 4.372 m. Later map/plane audit qualifies an association-only diagnosis.

title: Tracking improves while recovery remains unresolved
text: Robust observations and measured lines improve typical tracking. Tail errors and field symmetry remain integration limits.
refs: Reports [19]-[21]. Separate suites and scales, do not pool. Synthetic heading. Measured-line test reused development trajectories. Map counts/plane inconsistencies and local failures accompany 180-degree symmetry.

title: A focused software fix and a reproducible handoff
text:
C++ likelihood-gate defect diagnosed and corrected
Component, Gazebo and real-Chape runtime validation
Code, model contracts, reports and checked artifacts
sub: Next: team review, real accuracy data and an agreed CPU budget
refs: Reports [17]-[18]. The patch remains review-ready, not merged or deployed. Real-Chape regression is runtime/interface evidence without pose ground truth. All scientific claims remain tied to their protocol. Repository: github.com/yacinezah/robocup-humanoid-perception.
